action: Resolve standalone twin selection against complete player and traffic body selection.
observation: Standalone packaged modular engine; no ordinary geometry consumer established. All roster plans use complete whole bodies. Pelican and Ironback map to twin only in the bypassed modular selector; Mule/Atlas reaction_l definitions have explicit industrial mappings and also use whole bodies. Unknown identities select small ion; miner traffic selects Helios Cradle. An incomplete engine library can reach hashed fallback; no live route causing that condition observed. VFX profile engine_ion_twin is independently active and does not prove use of this GLB.
decision: Do not change live Pelican or Ironback engines by editing this unrelated modular package. Keep production untouched until a consumer is established.
next: Inspect retained package form and cost, then prioritize the integrated player-facing body.
performance: No ordinary target draw or frame-time claim.

action: Trace paired drive bindings, authored LOD, culling and material boundaries before considering static merging.
observation: Six named drive meshes retain distinct P/S anchors. Secondary fan rotation and core/plume scale factors synchronize to primary. decision: Never merge drive hooks or MAIN LOD boundary into static details. No extra shader or normal map is needed; preserve current source UVs and roles.

action: Inspect current packaged twin at fitted end-on, overhead and default chase scale, checking submissions before judging.
observation: Side, top and chase each submit all 17 pieces with no logged errors. The first fitted place frame submits16 and is excluded. Top reads as a broad dark plate with paired shallow tubes and cyan lines; end-on contains detached-looking small details. At default chase the component is only about20 pixels across and fine machining cannot read. This does not meet the intended richer manufactured appearance at fitted scale.
decision: Preserve the imperfect baseline and unresolved first-frame admission issue. Do not simplify or restyle an unproven live consumer. Prioritize the integrated Pelican body; twin remains incomplete against its20-pass target.
next: Revisit twin refinement if an actual geometry consumer or a deliberate reuse requirement is established.
